nodes.name: Daily 08:00
nodes.notes: One run/day is enough for a daily digest. Split into a separate Collector workflow (see README) if you want each source on its own schedule.

nodes.name: FTOP: Search Calls
nodes.notes: SEDIA (Funding & Tenders Portal search API) is not officially documented by the Commission. This query/endpoint is reverse-engineered from public usage and can change without notice -- see README > Limitations.

nodes.name: Cascade Funding: Fetch Listing
nodes.notes: HTML source -- fragile by nature. See the Normalize node: 0 matched elements throws instead of silently reporting 'no calls'.

nodes.name: Cascade Funding: Parse Listing
nodes.notes: Placeholder selectors (.call-item / h3 / .deadline / .summary). Open the live page and update these before running for real -- see README > Limitations.

nodes.name: Check Not Seen (L1)
nodes.notes: Level-1 dedup: same source_code + external_id seen on a previous run. Requires a 'raw_calls' Data Table -- see README > Setup.

nodes.name: Check Not Duplicate (L2)
nodes.notes: Level-2 dedup: same opportunity already stored under a different source_code. MVP simplification of the doc's 'keep highest completeness, others to aliases' rule -- here the first-seen source simply wins and later duplicates are dropped.

nodes.name: Extract Eligibility Criteria

parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"consortium_required": {"type": ["boolean", "null"], "description": "Whether the call requires a multi-partner consortium"}, "consortium_required_quote": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Verbatim sentence from the source text supporting consortium_required. Must be an exact substring of the input."}, "min_partners": {"type": ["number", "null"], "description": "Minimum number of partner organisations required"}, "min_partners_quote": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Verbatim supporting sentence, exact substring of the input"}, "min_countries": {"type": ["number", "null"], "description": "Minimum number of different eligible countries required"}, "min_countries_quote": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Verbatim supporting sentence, exact substring of the input"}, "applicant_types": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "Eligible applicant types, e.g. sme, startup, research, public, ngo, natural_person"}, "applicant_types_quote": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Verbatim supporting sentence, exact substring of the input"}, "trl_min": {"type": ["number", "null"], "description": "Minimum required Technology Readiness Level"}, "trl_max": {"type": ["number", "null"], "description": "Maximum required Technology Readiness Level"}, "trl_quote": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Verbatim supporting sentence, exact substring of the input"}, "cofinancing_pct": {"type": ["number", "null"], "description": "Percentage of project cost the applicant must co-finance"}, "cofinancing_pct_quote": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Verbatim supporting sentence, exact substring of the input"}}, "required": []}

nodes.notes: Every extracted field is paired with a *_quote field. The next node (Validate Citations & Score) drops any field whose quote is not a literal substring of raw_text -- see README > Design notes.

nodes.name: Get Unnotified Calls
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData is ON so the pipeline still runs (and sends the 'no matches' digest) when there is nothing pending. Reads across ALL runs, not just today's -- so a call that matched the profile but wasn't sent yet (e.g. after an error) is retried next run.
